items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I think Keith Thomas has been there with them too, in Brazil.

ctx.x: Did you say you went to Belgium too? Yeah. Did you hear any bands there?

No, I never got an opportunity to hear any bands. I know there is clubs and there is bands in there. I went to a club but I never went into it. I left on, I wanted to hear a particular band but they weren't there at the time so I left. I never heard any bands. I know there is bands and I know they like music because these guys in Barry Martin's band, they've been over there and played a lot. I think Keith Thomas has been there with them too, in Brazil.
Where else did you hear bands in, in Europe?
